errors.text_span: wobei die Werte in ganzen und Dezimalzahlen angegeben sind
errors.evidence: This phrase is part of the description of the horizontal axis, but the tick labels on the axis are whole numbers (0, 5, 10, etc.). The decimal values mentioned are the data labels next to the bars, not a feature of the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge nach Prozentwert angeordnet
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order by value. For example, the top bar, 'Unsicherheit', has a value of 24.56%, which is less than the second bar, 'Zutrauen', with a value of 25.40%.
